workflow_name: Compute and analyze thermoelectric power factor
definition: This workflow computes the thermoelectric power factor (PF = S^2σ or α^2/ρ) from measured Seebeck coefficient and electrical conductivity/resistivity data, and analyzes its temperature dependence and composition/processing-parameter dependence to identify optimal conditions maximizing PF.

tag_meta.verify_note: 通过将计算得到的PF(T)曲线、最大值与文献报道的值进行数值比较（误差容限内）来验证复现是否正确。
tag_meta.lab_type_reason: 该工作流仅对已有的实验测量数据进行数值计算、绘图和分析，无需进行新的实验。
